findings.title: New Windows service installed
findings.consumer_text: A new Windows service was installed on this computer. Services can run automatically and may be used to maintain access to a system.
findings.false_positive_note: Legitimate software installations, updates, and administrative tools commonly create new Windows services.
next_steps: Identify the newly installed service.
Check the executable path associated with the service.
Verify that the installation was authorized.
Investigate unfamiliar or suspicious services.
findings.analyst_notes: Review System Event ID 7045. Examine the service name, executable path, service type, and account used to run it. Correlate with process creation and other persistence events.
